# WebMD
> Trusted consumer health information covering symptoms, conditions, drugs, wellness, news, and medical reference.

WebMD publishes medically reviewed health content for patients and caregivers, including disease overviews, symptom guidance, drug and supplement reference, healthy living advice, and current health news. Content is organized into condition centers, topic hubs, tools, and reference libraries.

## Core Reference
- [WebMD Home](https://www.webmd.com/): Main entry to WebMD health information, tools, condition centers, and news.
- [Health A-Z](https://www.webmd.com/a-to-z-guides/health-topics): Alphabetical directory of diseases, conditions, and health topics.
- [Medical Reference](https://www.webmd.com/a-to-z-guides/common-topics/default.htm): Broad medical reference hub for symptoms, tests, treatments, and conditions.
- [First Aid & Emergencies](https://www.webmd.com/first-aid/default.htm): Emergency care, first aid steps, and urgent symptom guidance.
- [WebMD News](https://www.webmd.com/news/default.htm): Timely health, medicine, public health, and research news coverage.
- [Blogs](https://blogs.webmd.com/): Expert and contributor blogs on health, care, and living well.

## Symptoms, Diagnosis, and Tools
- [Symptom Checker](https://symptoms.webmd.com/): Interactive symptom assessment tool for possible causes and next steps.
- [Medical Tests](https://www.webmd.com/a-to-z-guides/medical-tests-default.htm): Explanations of common diagnostic tests, screenings, and procedures.
- [Common Symptoms](https://www.webmd.com/a-to-z-guides/common-topics/default.htm): Reference pages for symptoms, causes, and when to seek care.
- [First Aid Guide](https://www.webmd.com/first-aid/default.htm): Practical first aid instructions for injuries, bites, burns, and emergencies.
- [Drugs & Medications](https://www.webmd.com/drugs/2/index): Searchable prescription and over-the-counter medication reference.
- [Vitamins & Supplements](https://www.webmd.com/vitamins/index): Ingredient reference for supplements, uses, safety, and interactions.

## Drugs, Supplements, and Pharmacy
- [Drugs & Medications](https://www.webmd.com/drugs/2/index): Drug monographs with uses, dosage, side effects, and precautions.
- [Pill Identifier](https://www.webmd.com/pill-identification/default.htm): Identify pills by imprint, shape, color, and form.
- [Interaction Checker](https://www.webmd.com/interaction-checker/default.htm): Check potential interactions among drugs, supplements, and foods.
- [Vitamins & Supplements Center](https://www.webmd.com/vitamins/index): Supplement database with evidence, dosing, and safety information.
- [Medication Overview](https://www.webmd.com/drugs/2/index): Browse medications by name, condition, or therapeutic category.

## Conditions and Diseases
- [Heart Disease](https://www.webmd.com/heart-disease/default.htm): Heart conditions, symptoms, prevention, tests, and treatment information.
- [Diabetes](https://www.webmd.com/diabetes/default.htm): Type 1, type 2, complications, monitoring, and diabetes management guidance.
- [Cancer](https://www.webmd.com/cancer/default.htm): Cancer types, screening, diagnosis, treatment, and supportive care topics.
- [Arthritis](https://www.webmd.com/arthritis/default.htm): Osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, joint pain, and treatment options.
- [Lung Disease & Respiratory Health](https://www.webmd.com/lung/default.htm): Asthma, COPD, infections, breathing symptoms, and lung care.
- [Digestive Disorders](https://www.webmd.com/digestive-disorders/default.htm): GI conditions, symptoms, tests, and digestive health information.
- [Skin Problems & Treatments](https://www.webmd.com/skin-problems-and-treatments/default.htm): Skin conditions, rashes, treatments, and skincare guidance.
- [Eye Health](https://www.webmd.com/eye-health/default.htm): Vision conditions, eye symptoms, exams, and treatment information.

## Mental Health and Brain
- [Mental Health](https://www.webmd.com/mental-health/default.htm): Mental health conditions, therapy, medications, and coping resources.
- [Depression](https://www.webmd.com/depression/default.htm): Depression symptoms, diagnosis, treatment, and self-care information.
- [Anxiety & Panic Disorders](https://www.webmd.com/anxiety-panic/default.htm): Anxiety symptoms, panic attacks, causes, and treatment options.
- [ADD/ADHD](https://www.webmd.com/add-adhd/default.htm): ADHD symptoms, diagnosis, medications, and support for children and adults.
- [Schizophrenia](https://www.webmd.com/schizophrenia/default.htm): Schizophrenia symptoms, treatment approaches, and caregiving information.
- [Sleep Disorders](https://www.webmd.com/sleep-disorders/default.htm): Insomnia, sleep apnea, sleep hygiene, and sleep-related conditions.
- [Brain & Nervous System](https://www.webmd.com/brain/default.htm): Neurologic conditions, headaches, seizures, and brain health topics.

## Women’s Health
- [Women's Health](https://www.webmd.com/women/default.htm): Women’s wellness, reproductive health, screenings, and life-stage guidance.
- [Pregnancy & Baby](https://www.webmd.com/baby/default.htm): Pregnancy, childbirth, newborn care, and parenting health information.
- [Breast Cancer](https://www.webmd.com/breast-cancer/default.htm): Breast cancer symptoms, screening, diagnosis, and treatment basics.
- [Osteoporosis](https://www.webmd.com/osteoporosis/default.htm): Bone health, fracture prevention, testing, and treatment options.
- [Sexual Health](https://www.webmd.com/sex/default.htm): Sexual wellness, STIs, contraception, and relationship health topics.
- [Menopause](https://www.webmd.com/menopause/default.htm): Menopause symptoms, hormone therapy, and symptom management.

## Men’s Health
- [Men's Health](https://www.webmd.com/men/default.htm): Men’s wellness, screenings, sexual health, and common conditions.
- [Erectile Dysfunction](https://www.webmd.com/erectile-dysfunction/default.htm): Causes, evaluation, treatments, and lifestyle considerations.
- [Prostate Cancer](https://www.webmd.com/prostate-cancer/default.htm): Screening, diagnosis, staging, and treatment information.
- [Sexual Health](https://www.webmd.com/sex/default.htm): Sexual function, STIs, contraception, and relationship health guidance.
- [Fitness & Exercise](https://www.webmd.com/fitness-exercise/default.htm): Exercise advice, activity plans, and physical health benefits.

## Children and Family
- [Children's Health](https://www.webmd.com/children/default.htm): Pediatric conditions, symptoms, safety, and family health guidance.
- [Parenting](https://www.webmd.com/parenting/default.htm): Parenting advice, child development, and everyday family health topics.
- [ADHD in Children](https://www.webmd.com/add-adhd/default.htm): ADHD symptoms, diagnosis, school support, and treatment options.
- [Allergies in Children](https://www.webmd.com/allergies/default.htm): Allergy symptoms, triggers, testing, and treatment basics.
- [Vaccines](https://www.webmd.com/vaccines/default.htm): Vaccine information, schedules, safety, and immunization guidance.

## Healthy Living
- [Diet & Weight Management](https://www.webmd.com/diet/default.htm): Nutrition, weight loss, diets, and healthy eating advice.
- [Fitness & Exercise](https://www.webmd.com/fitness-exercise/default.htm): Workouts, movement guidance, and exercise benefits for health.
- [Food & Recipes](https://www.webmd.com/food-recipes/default.htm): Healthy eating ideas, recipes, and nutrition-focused food content.
- [Sleep](https://www.webmd.com/sleep-disorders/default.htm): Sleep habits, disorders, and strategies for better rest.
- [Oral Care](https://www.webmd.com/oral-health/default.htm): Dental conditions, hygiene, procedures, and oral health maintenance.
- [Healthy Beauty](https://www.webmd.com/beauty/default.htm): Beauty and skincare topics with health-focused guidance.

## Specialized Topic Centers
- [Allergies](https://www.webmd.com/allergies/default.htm): Seasonal, food, and environmental allergy information and treatment guidance.
- [Asthma](https://www.webmd.com/asthma/default.htm): Asthma symptoms, triggers, medications, and action plan support.
- [Migraine & Headaches](https://www.webmd.com/migraines-headaches/default.htm): Headache types, migraine treatments, and symptom management.
- [Pain Management](https://www.webmd.com/pain-management/default.htm): Chronic pain conditions, treatments, and coping strategies.
- [Sexual Conditions](https://www.webmd.com/sex-relationships/default.htm): Relationship, intimacy, and sexual health education.
- [Cold, Flu & Cough](https://www.webmd.com/cold-and-flu/default.htm): Respiratory infection symptoms, self-care, and treatment information.
- [Heartburn/GERD](https://www.webmd.com/heartburn-gerd/default.htm): Reflux symptoms, causes, diagnosis, and treatment options.
- [Rheumatoid Arthritis](https://www.webmd.com/rheumatoid-arthritis/default.htm): RA symptoms, medications, flares, and long-term management.

## News and Editorial
- [Health News](https://www.webmd.com/news/default.htm): Daily reporting on medical research, policy, and public health developments.
- [Feature Stories](https://www.webmd.com/news/features/default.htm): In-depth health features, explainers, and patient-focused reporting.
- [Blogs](https://blogs.webmd.com/): Ongoing commentary and personal perspectives from WebMD contributors.
- [Slideshows](https://www.webmd.com/slideshow/default.htm): Visual explainers on conditions, treatments, and healthy living topics.
- [Quizzes](https://www.webmd.com/quizzes/default.htm): Educational quizzes covering symptoms, conditions, and wellness topics.
